All tools/Remove PDF Pages

Remove PDF Pages

Remove unwanted pages and keep the rest.

Use page numbers and ranges, for example 1, 3-5. Extracted pages follow your chosen order. For rotation, leave blank to rotate all pages.

Your files stay yours. All processing happens on your device.

How to use this tool

  1. Choose an unencrypted PDF.
  2. Enter page numbers or ranges, such as 1, 3-5.
  3. Download and review your new PDF. The original stays unchanged.

Good to know

What should I expect?

This tool changes PDF pages locally. Password-protected or damaged files are rejected. Interactive forms, bookmarks and digital signatures may not be preserved. Review your output.

Are my files uploaded?

No. Files stay in your browser. No file content is sent to a server.
